primitives.name: Overinference Weak Signals
primitives.verbatim_quote: DnC-10 → 88.61% / 98.41; batch-10 optimal strong, batch-3 weak, batch-1 worst everywhere | DnC-10 ≈ 10× call cost, no cost analysis in paper | `arxiv-program/research/2026-09-21/arxiv-deep/1723-reasoning-information-aggregation-sports-narratives.md:45-46,60` | VERIFIED* | Adopt the *evaluation methodology* (DCA, DnC-10, synthetic stress), never the expectation that LLMs aggregate reliably.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Ŝ: perceived signal (dimensionless), S: true signal strength (dimensionless), k: scaling factor (dimensionless), β: exponent (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: DGP-agnostic model, linear expectation E[M]=E[R], large-scale transaction data (>5M Betfair trades across 5 sports)
primitives.breakdown_regime: Underinference occurs at high diagnosticity thresholds (p≥2/3), causing signal reversal in late observation windows

layer2.mapping: Maps overinference dynamics to GSI's efficient-market hypothesis (EMH) testing framework, where observed price movements exceed information-theoretic uncertainty reduction, indicating systematic mispricing. In GSE, this maps to situational reasoning failure when agents overreact to weak signals, leading to exploitable volatility.
layer2.telemetry: Empirical verification metrics include: 1) Information gain relative to entropy reduction, 2) Late-stage signal reversal frequency (e.g., NBA Q3 crossover), 3) Lab-based underinference diagnostics at p≥2/3 thresholds

primitives.name: Alternative Pythagorean
primitives.verbatim_quote: DnC-10 → 88.61% / 98.41; batch-10 optimal strong, batch-3 weak, batch-1 worst everywhere | DnC-10 ≈ 10× call cost, no cost analysis in paper | `arxiv-program/research/2026-09-21/arxiv-deep/1723-reasoning-information-aggregation-sports-narratives.md:45-46,60` | VERIFIED* | Adopt the *evaluation methodology* (DCA, DnC-10, synthetic stress), never the expectation that LLMs aggregate reliably.
primitives.assumptions: Statistical vs practical significance distinction, large-N artifact correction applied
primitives.breakdown_regime: Astronomical Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) ratios indicate overfitting to sample size rather than predictive power

layer2.mapping: Maps the alternative Pythagorean framework to GSI's predictive modeling pipeline, where Tullock exponent-based models (e.g., 1.722) are compared against difference-form parameters (0.003). The key mapping is to conformal prediction intervals that assess whether small ΔR² (0.003) and ΔRMSE (0.001) translate into actionable edge in betting markets, filtering out spurious correlations.
layer2.telemetry: Verification metrics include: 1) Out-of-sample RMSE differential between competing models, 2) Fractional logit refitting performance on NFL data (2000-2025), 3) Stability of predictions across expanding windows of historical data

primitives.name: OpenFE Automated Feature Generation
primitives.verbatim_quote: DnC-10 → 88.61% / 98.41; batch-10 optimal strong, batch-3 weak, batch-1 worst everywhere | DnC-10 ≈ 10× call cost, no cost analysis in paper | `arxiv-program/research/2026-09-21/arxiv-deep/1723-reasoning-information-aggregation-sports-narratives.md:45-46,60` | VERIFIED* | Adopt the *evaluation methodology* (DCA, DnC-10, synthetic stress), never the expectation that LLMs aggregate reliably.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Accuracy: fraction of correct predictions (dimensionless), Rank: normalized fraud detection ranking (dimensionless), BNP: Balanced Accuracy (dimensionless), MI: Mutual Information (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Cross-validation on 10 datasets with 10 repeats, Welch t-test p=0.05
primitives.breakdown_regime: Time-series non-stationarity causes catastrophic degradation when direct application to sequential data without temporal validation

layer2.mapping: Maps OpenFE's feature programming to GSE's situational reasoning by treating feature transformations (e.g., differences, windows, shifts) as state-transition kernels. The key mapping is to expandable-window pre-training on pre-game statistics, ensuring ≥3-of-4-season stability filters prevent overfitting to short-term market regimes.
layer2.telemetry: Empirical observables include: 1) Feature stability across rolling training windows, 2) Reduction in pruning-ablation errors, 3) Cross-domain transferability to new sports or leagues

primitives.name: Feature Programming Dynamics
primitives.verbatim_quote: Brief's ≥20% violator-underperformance gate on 2024 DK GPP backtests is the honest test.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: R²: coefficient of determination (dimensionless), Pearson: Pearson correlation coefficient (dimensionless), Time: computational runtime (seconds)
primitives.assumptions: Taxi dataset benchmark, fixed computational budget
primitives.breakdown_regime: Computational complexity scales super-linearly with horizon length, creating a bottleneck for real-time deployment

layer2.mapping: Maps feature-programming gains to GSE's state-transition logic by interpreting transformation pipelines as Markov decision processes. The mapping identifies the trade-off between immediate reward (one-step R²) and long-term value (+88% R², +27% Pearson) as a reinforcement learning objective, where the taxi training time becomes the episode cost.
layer2.telemetry: Key telemetry metrics are: 1) Horizon-length scaling of predictive performance, 2) Episode cost (training time) per transition, 3) State-action space sparsity due to high-order differencing

reasoning_traces.think:
The four primitives form a unified mathematical architecture for handling noisy, high-dimensional betting data. Overinference Weak Signals describes how agents systematically misprice extreme events; Alternative Pythagorean provides a robust statistical test to distinguish genuine predictive power from large-N artifacts; OpenFE Automated Feature Generation offers scalable, interpretable feature extraction; and Feature Programming Dynamics captures the temporal evolution of these features. Together, they map to GSI's conformal prediction and GSE's Markov decision process frameworks, enabling rigorous out-of-sample validation and real-time decision-making.
